speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to understand the underlying cause, could you please describe exactly what these symptoms feel like and when they first started? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your vision, speech, or balance over the past few months?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for describing your symptoms; the "drunken" appearance of your gait and right-sided clumsiness suggest a focal neurological issue. Given your significant medical history, could you tell me specifically what conditions you have been treated for previously?
